text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Invited by Oguri Cap, Tamamo Cross entered 
the second leg of the GⅠ triple-header, 
the Japan Cup, and emerged victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, pushing her body to the absolute 
limit resulted in a razor-thin victory... 
Praying that her body would hold up, she 
headed toward the decisive battle: the 
Arima Kinen.
